title: Improve Network tile readability
summary: Improve the Network page Mode Summary and Mode Model readability by rendering each summary line as a spaced row tile instead of a dense preformatted block.
reason: The existing Network summary tile compressed natural-language guidance into a low-contrast pre block, making the saved role and read-only guidance harder to scan.
behavior_before: Network Mode Summary and Mode Model guidance rendered as preformatted prose blocks with dense line wrapping.
behavior_after: Network Mode Summary and Mode Model guidance render as readable row tiles with stronger labels, values, spacing, and contrast while remaining read-only.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed only for unrelated uncovered dirty file src/mediapipeline/tools/dev/check_legacy_removal_readiness.py
rollback_plan: Revert the Network summary row renderer, restore the two Network summary containers to pre.prose-block markup, remove the page CSS block and smoke assertion, and remove this change packet.
notes: Rendered Network Mode Summary and Mode Model as readable row tiles instead of dense preformatted summary text.
